name: safepath-root
description: Root workspace configuration for SafePath Emergency Mapping

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
